scope: MRT only; historical training period2021-01..2025-03 and origin-known forecast covariates. Exclude incomplete LRT-only rows in supplied MRT table.
pre2021_rule: NS integer1..28 except6; EW1..33; CG1,CG2; NE1..17 except2; CC1..29 except18 plus suppliedCC33(MarinaBay),CC34(Bayfront); DT1..35 except4; TE1..3. Original STATUS is not used to infer history.
pre2021_limit: Older operational lines require final route-map cross-check before a new training experiment. Supplied station codes include nonstandard CCL branch coding; use names for physical-station deduplication, and do not infer graph edges blindly by code number.
month_policy: Station enters on first complete calendar month after actual opening date, because approvals have month precision only. For a held-out forecast origin, use only announcements published by that origin; unknown future openings remain unavailable.

future_exclusions.reason: CrossIslandLine not operating in2021-2025; primary dated2025 release gives progressive opening from2030.
JurongRegionLine not operating in2021-2025; dated2025 release places stages in2027-2029. Later2026delay not used to set historical predictions.
CCL6/TEL5/DTLextension were future projects throughout historical training period.
Brickland targeted2034, not operating in historical data.
MountPleasant,MarinaSouth,FoundersMemorial andChangiTerminal5 are not operational parts of TEL1-4 in2021-2025.
